product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.summary: The rackmount Systema with room for 4 processors.
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.history: The SNX 400 was part of Systema before the 460 announcement in December 1995. The guide identifies the RM rackmount variant.
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.architecture: Processors could be added on cards. The 64-bit Corollary C-Bus II connects up to 4 processor cards to memory.
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.service-guid: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 3
product.olivetti-snx-400-rm.computerwoch: Computerwoche, Olivetti-Server mit Pentium Pro nutzen Platinendesign von Intel, 22 December 1995
